name: Encrusted Tail Fins
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts fears the rocket car’s speed will tear it apart. Saltscale murloc tail fins from the Vile Reef off Stranglethorn Vale may protect it.

sections.title: A Coating for the Car
sections.body: Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats. Yet friction may tear it apart. Its moving parts need a coating that is hard without being brittle and can resist salt corrosion. Otherwise, the flats will eat away at the car. The key ingredient is ten tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef off Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: The Finished Composite
sections.body: Wizzle grinds the fins to powder and mixes them with a few other ingredients. The finished composite should protect the car from its own speed, as long as it does not hit anything.

faq.q: Why does Wizzle Brassbolts need encrusted tail fins?
faq.answer: Wizzle fears the rocket car is so fast that friction will tear it apart. The fins are a key ingredient in a composite for its moving parts, hard without being brittle and resistant to salt corrosion.

faq.q: Where can the Saltscale murlocs be found?
faq.answer: The Saltscale murlocs live at the Vile Reef off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, almost due west of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: What came before this for Wizzle?
faq.answer: Hardened Shells comes before Encrusted Tail Fins in the chain.
Wizzle Brassbolts is at the Mirage Raceway. Worried that friction will tear the rocket car apart, he asks you to bring him the fins.
